description:
## Overview

Preview the refund amount and cancellation fee for a booking before committing to cancel it.

## When to Use

- **Cancellation confirmation screens** - Show the guest exactly what they'll be refunded
- **Support tooling** - Check whether a booking is still cancellable before offering a refund

## What You Get

- **`cancellable`** - Whether the booking can currently be cancelled
- **`policy`** - `cancellationFee`, `refundAmount`, `refundType`, `estimateConfidence`, `currency`, `sellingPrice`

## Quick Start

Use this with the `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. This does not cancel the booking - `cancelExperienceBooking` cancels it.

## Error codes

Product-operation codes are listed below. Shared authentication/access/rate-limit middleware can return common codes such as 401, 40301 or 4290. HTTP status and error code are separate; do not parse message text.

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 75001 | booking not found |
| 75002 | this booking has already been cancelled |
| 75003 | cancellation is not allowed for this booking |
| 75004 | the activity has already started |
| 75005 | invalid cancellation preview request |
| 75006 | cancellation preview provider request failed |
| 75007 | cancellation preview provider request timed out |
| 75008 | cancellation preview request is unauthorized |
| 75009 | cancellation preview request is forbidden |
| 75010 | cancellation preview service is temporarily unavailable |
| 75099 | failed to retrieve cancellation preview |

Requires the `bookingId` and the `email` used to book: the server only returns or changes a booking when they match.

bookingId.description: MAQAMI experience booking ID from the booking confirmation

email.description: The email address used to make the booking. The server checks it against the booking before returning or changing anything.

lastName.description: The booking holder's last name, if the customer gives it. Optional.

title: Preview tour cancellation
